name: Tuberous sclerosis
value: 4-year-old boy whose mother felt a lump in his belly. Exam: pale oval patches on his back, small red papules over his nose and cheeks, a firm left flank mass. BP 104/66. Ultrasound: bright, echogenic masses in both kidneys.

name: Clear cell renal cell carcinoma
value: 58-year-old man, 40 pack-years: painless visible hematuria and dull left flank pain, with 4 kg weight loss. New left scrotal varicocele. BP 150/92. Hb 18.9 g/dL, calcium 9.4 mg/dL.
